# Libraries

```{r}
#| warning: false

.packages <- c(
  "dplyr",
  "readxl",
  "tidyr",
  "magrittr",
  "fs",
  "visdat",
  "here",
  # Plotting
  "MetBrewer",
  "ggplot2",
  "patchwork"
)

.installed_packages <- .packages %in% rownames(installed.packages())
if (any(.installed_packages == F)) {
  install.packages(.packages[!.installed_packages])
}

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  invisible(lapply(.packages, library, character.only = T))
})
```

# Set up

```{r}
#| include: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, # inches
  fig.height = 8, # inches
  cache = TRUE # Cache results to speed up subsequent renders
)
```
